svg.aria-label: Close-Grip Bench Press, Top: Start with feet planted and the bar above your chest in a shoulder-width overhand grip.
svg.title: Close-Grip Bench Press, Top: Start with feet planted and the bar above your chest in a shoulder-width overhand grip.

svg.aria-label: Close-Grip Bench Press, Lower: Lower the bar toward your lower chest, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
svg.title: Close-Grip Bench Press, Lower: Lower the bar toward your lower chest, keeping your elbows close to your sides.

svg.aria-label: Close-Grip Bench Press, Chest: Briefly touch your lower chest while keeping your shoulders supported.
svg.title: Close-Grip Bench Press, Chest: Briefly touch your lower chest while keeping your shoulders supported.

svg.aria-label: Close-Grip Bench Press, Press: Press the bar back up without lifting your shoulders from the bench.
svg.title: Close-Grip Bench Press, Press: Press the bar back up without lifting your shoulders from the bench.
